rendering: Original approved RGB + generated silhouette mask, composed once into cached transparent Godot viewports. No repainting of the approved originals.
prompt: Create a precise binary foreground segmentation mask for the attached image, for a game engine alpha matte. EDIT the input: every pixel belonging to the character/creature and its equipment must be solid pure white (#FFFFFF). Every background pixel and floor shadow must be solid pure black (#000000). Keep the EXACT original image canvas aspect ratio, original subject scale and pixel position: do not zoom, crop, move, reframe, or change pose. Trace the exact external silhouette including fingers, claws, hair, horns, wings, weapon tips and tail. Negative spaces between limbs and holes through wings must be black. Inside the subject silhouette must be completely solid white, including dark clothing, eyes and mouth cavities that are part of the subject. No details or grey shading within the white silhouette. No colored character, no background texture, no pattern, no labels. Output only this flat black and white MASK, not a cutout or illustration. Black background is required; do not use transparency.
